title: Release of Stay Earnings to Payout Methods
content:
A stay's earnings are released to a host's Payout Methods once the stay qualifies and the release time has passed. A stay's earnings are its nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total less the host service fee assessed on it, all net of host-funded refunds already issued.

## Conditions for a release

All three of the following are read from the system records, never from a statement by the host or the guest.

**1. Stay status.** Earnings are released only for a stay that has checked in, has completed, or was cancelled by the guest. The stay's status on its own record is the evidence, matched to the stay being released.

**2. Release time.** Earnings are released no earlier than 24 elapsed hours after the start of the stay's check-in date; the hours run from 00:00 on the check-in date, so the earliest release falls on the next calendar day. The clock starts at 00:00 on the check-in date shown on the stay's record; the release is allowed at the moment the 24 hours are complete and at any time after, and not before.

**3. One release per installment.** Each stay installment is released once. Where the payout ledger already shows a release for the same stay and the same installment number, no second release is made.

## What is released

- **Stay paid in full or in two parts:** one release, installment 1.
- **Monthly-installment stay:** each installment's earnings are released 24 hours after the start of the first night it covers, as installment n for the nth monthly installment.
- **Stay cancelled by the guest before check-in:** the release is the host-funded amount the guest did not get back, on the same schedule counted from the original check-in date.

## Boundary cases on the release time (hypothetical dates)

| Check-in date on the stay record | Moment considered | Release allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-06-10, any hour | No: fewer than 24 hours since 00:00 on 2026-06-10 |
| 2026-06-10 | 2026-06-11, from 00:00 | Yes: 24 hours complete at 00:00 on 2026-06-11 |
| 2026-06-10, guest cancelled on 2026-05-20 | 2026-06-11 | Yes for the host-funded amount the guest did not get back, timed from the original check-in date |

## Condition combinations

| Stay status | 24 hours from 00:00 on check-in date complete | Release already on the ledger for this stay and installment | Release made |
|---|---|---|---|
| Checked in, completed or cancelled by the guest | Yes | No | Yes |
| Checked in, completed or cancelled by the guest | No | — | No |
| Any | — | Yes | No |
| Any other status | — | — | No |

## Hypothetical amount example

An imagined stay has a nightly subtotal of USD 900.00, a cleaning fee of USD 120.00, a pet fee total of USD 40.00 and no extra-guest fee, a host service fee of USD 31.80, and no host-funded refund. Its earnings are USD 1060.00 less USD 31.80, that is USD 1028.20.
